messages.body:
Hello Barclays Recruitment Team,

I am emailing to highlight my continued interest in Barclays recruiting. I submitted my applications for numerous Banking Analyst Internship Programs (2025) and subsequently completed the online assessments, but have not heard back with any next steps. I am still incredibly interested in continuing to pursue recruitment with Barclays if at all possible. Additionally, an updated copy of my resume is attached to this email.

Best,
Jonathan Nachman
